summary: The sheet contains two wall sections, structural design criteria, steel, wood, reinforced concrete, masonry/foundation, light-gage steel, submittal, and special-inspection notes. Preliminary observations are limited to sheet-local drafting, document-control, and clarification concerns visible on this sheet.

drafts.title: Wall section 2 scale notation is incomplete
drafts.observation: The caption beneath wall section 2 reads `SCALE: 3/4"1'-0"`, while wall section 1 is shown as `SCALE: 3/4"=1'-0"`. The equal sign is missing from the wall section 2 scale notation.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Bottom caption beneath detail 2, WALL SECTION: `SCALE: 3/4"1'-0"`; detail 1 caption immediately to the left shows `SCALE: 3/4"=1'-0"`.
drafts.drawing_location: Bottom of sheet, beneath wall sections 1 and 2
drafts.recommendation: Correct the wall section 2 scale notation or identify it as not to scale if that is intended.

drafts.title: Sheet-count field appears incomplete
drafts.observation: The title block identifies the page as `S-201.00`, but the adjacent sheet-count field reads `OF 00`. This appears to be an incomplete or placeholder document-control entry.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Title block fields at lower right: `PAGE #: S-201.00` and `SHEET: OF 00`.
drafts.recommendation: Verify and update the total-sheet field, or confirm that `OF 00` is an intentional project-standard notation.

drafts.title: Typical-section reference is not specifically identified
drafts.observation: Both wall section details include the note `2X4 REPAIR SEE TYPICAL SECTION`, but the note does not identify a sheet number or detail number. The submitted index includes other structural sheets, but none was reviewed here to determine which detail is intended.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Wall section 1 and wall section 2 each contain the annotation `2X4 REPAIR SEE TYPICAL SECTION`.
drafts.drawing_location: Within the wall section diagrams, adjacent to the 2x4 repair callouts
drafts.recommendation: Add the specific sheet and detail reference for the 2x4 repair condition, or confirm the location of the applicable typical section in the structural set.

drafts.title: Snow-load design input and governing selection should be clarified
drafts.observation: The design criteria list `ROOF LIVE LOAD: 30 PSF`, `GROUND SNOW LOAD: 25 PSF`, and `OR 30 PSF EQUIVALENT UNIFORM LOAD`. The sheet does not state how the listed snow-load values are selected or coordinated with the roof design criterion.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Design Criteria block lists `ROOF LIVE LOAD: 30 PSF`, `GROUND SNOW LOAD: 25 PSF`, and `OR 30 PSF EQUIVALENT UNIFORM LOAD`; it also states `NO REDUCTIONS IN ROOF LIVE LOAD PERMITTED`.
drafts.recommendation: Have the structural design professional clarify the governing roof snow/live-load input and show the applicable selection method in the calculations or design criteria.
